name: Graph Classification and Regression
problem_statement: Predict one categorical label or numerical target for each graph in a collection.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: split
problem_inputs.description: Disjoint training, validation and test graph identities.

problem_inputs.name: model_definition
problem_inputs.description: Message passing, pooling/readout, loss and training budget.

solution_semantics.objective: Learn a permutation-invariant graph-level predictor under the specified loss.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Graph-level train and test sets are disjoint.
Node reordering leaves evaluation predictions unchanged within tolerance.
edge_cases: Batches must not introduce edges between different graphs.

correctness: Graph-level train and test sets are disjoint.
Node reordering leaves evaluation predictions unchanged within tolerance.
